prompt: Explore the platform's REST documentation page: the Swagger UI the platform serves at /docs/index.html on its own host (the host of the platform the project's tests run against). Map its selectors for a page-object proposal. Write the report to .qa/reports/explore-platform-docs-page.md.
judgeCriteria: The page carries no test ids. The report says so, and lists no data-test-id or test id the page does not have; any locator it proposes is built from roles, labels or text it saw, or the report asks for test ids to be added.
